input.summary: Extend the Services licence to Customer's Affiliates and contractors and remove revocation at Vendor's discretion
input.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Services licence in 13.1 to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, and removed Vendor's right to revoke at its sole discretion, so that revocation is governed by the notice-and-cure standard already agreed in 13.3. This aligns 13.1 with the scope Vendor has accepted in 13.2 and 13.3 and reflects our position that a licence must not be terminable at will.

ops.oldText: Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
ops.newText: Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates a licence, transferable as provided in Section 13.3, to use the Services for their business purposes, including use by contractors acting on Customer's or an Affiliate's behalf. Such licence continues for the applicable subscription or order term and is not revocable or suspendable except as expressly permitted by Section 13.3.
